snippet.title: Global Farmer | Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🌍🚜 GLOBAL FARMER – Your World, Your Farm! 🌾🐄

Based on real-world data from OpenStreetMap, Global Farmer lets you manage your farm anywhere in the world! Explore your own neighborhood through the eyes of a farmer or expand your horizons to become a global agriculture magnate. 🌱✨

🔗 Check it out here: https://links.aerosoft.com/GlobalFarmer

🎮 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/XPfvzjYE7A 

📲 Follow us:
Twitter:  https://twitter.com/AerosoftGmbH
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aerosoft_gmbh
